payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the nature of the restricted track in the BEA 2019 Shared Task on grammatical error correction, indicating that it is a purely neural system without additional tools.

claims.text: The restricted track submission is a purely neural system that does not use additional tools like spell checkers.
The restricted track system is based on standard neural machine translation (NMT) and language model (LM) architectures.
Techniques from machine translation research, such as back-translation and fine-tuning, are utilized in the restricted track.
